goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: RE-LOCKED compute budget (2026-08-09). 10M/384 was TRIED (v27, iter-19) and is NON-CONVERGENT: 2.26 BPC @ 40ep (~12x fewer steps, ~875s) vs 1.70 BPC @ 30M/96. The canonical kernel train.ipynb runs at EXACTLY 30M/512/256/bs96. These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size to lower loss (compute inflation, rejected by push rule). Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, token_qk_norm, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept.

current_best.time_to_convergence: 2004s (33.4 min) fit time for 40 epochs -> 1.7047 BPC @ E40 at committed 30M/512/256/bs96 budget. 2x faster than iter-15's 3524s for 1.8833.
current_best.notes: Iter-20 (v33, kernel pushed as v33): token_dec 7L/896 -> NEW BEST 1.7047 BPC (in2kuivh, exalted-donkey-24, 2004s, 40/40 epochs). Winning lever: token-decoder scaling. Progression from best: 1.8833 (iter-15, 3L/256) -> 1.8780 (v26 QK-norm fix landed, breezy-tree-17) -> 1.8759 (v28) -> 1.8483 (v29 tdec 4L/384) -> [1.8749 v30 chunk 12L/2560 REGRESSION, reverted] -> 1.79396 (v31 tdec 5L/512) -> 1.71869 (v32 tdec 6L/768, warm-armadillo-23) -> 1.7047 (v33 tdec 7L/896). Chunk-side scale-up regressed (12L/2560: 1.8483->1.8749). v27's 10M/384 experiment non-convergent (2.26 BPC, hardy-aardvark-18).

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. Treat these fields as opaque labels when reading this file in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-21 (v34, in flight): sync canonical notebook to v33 config (30M/96, tdec 7L/896), add token_qk_norm=True probe (QK-norm currently only on chunk decoder; modded-nanogpt rec 5). Target: <1.7047 BPC.

Token-decoder scaling is the proven lever (3L/256 -> 7L/896: 1.8833 -> 1.7047), but gains are diminishing (6L->7L only -0.014). Do not scale past ~7L without a strong argument; probe orthogonal levers on the token decoder instead (token_qk_norm, softcap, window warmup curve, dropout).

Architecture tuning is OPEN (not locked): sweep/tune chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, token_qk_norm, lr, weight_decay — these are NOT compute-inflation and are the real BPC levers. Do NOT touch committed_budget fields.
Re-enable the online W&B sweep over token_dec_*/token_qk_norm once v34 is green.
